definitions.explanation: An elastic device that returns to its shape after being compressed or stretched.
The quality of being able to bounce back.

⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ばね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{跳|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: I jump using the spring in my legs.

examples.english: I grow by using failure as a springboard.

notes:
ばね refers to a mechanical spring or springiness. Can also be written as バネ or ⟦{発条|ばね}→ばね：noentry⟧ (rare kanji form).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ばね⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧: to have good springs, to be springy
- ばね⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れる→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧: the spring breaks
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ばね: leg spring (jumping ability)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦コイル→コイル：27287_koiru⟧ばね: coil spring
- ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧ばね: leaf spring
- ばね⟦{仕掛|じか}け→仕掛け：07916_shikake⟧: spring-loaded

FIGURATIVE:
ばね is often used figuratively to describe resilience or the ability to bounce back from adversity.
